observations: Photo 0, photo 1 and photo 2 show the same used automatic gearbox in a crowded spare parts market, surrounded by engines and parts.
It is a front-wheel-drive transaxle with the torque converter fitted, two metal cooler lines with a rubber hose, a bell housing and a drive shaft output seal.
The case is dusty and oil stained; no visible cracks at this resolution, but the underside and pan are not shown.
A white sticker on the case and a QR sticker on the torque converter are visible in photo 0 and photo 2 but no text on them is legible.
No Ford logo, transmission code or part number can be read in any photo.
Watermark 'GEARUP INC' and 'Posted on Jiji' on all three photos: a dealer's advert photos.
No photo of the electrical connector, the dipstick or fluid, or the mating face of the engine side.

identity.kind: used automatic transmission gearbox, front-wheel-drive transaxle with torque converter
read_from: photo 0, photo 1 and photo 2 show the type only; ID sticker and QR label not legible

claims.evidence: No Ford mark, transmission code or part number is legible in photo 0, photo 1 or photo 2; the shape is an ordinary transverse automatic transaxle that could fit several cars.
Nothing in the photos shows which engine the gearbox was mated to; only the transmission code would say.
Origin cannot be shown by photos of the part.

claims.claim: Let's know your engine capacity (several units in stock)
claims.evidence: Only one gearbox is shown; the one delivered may differ from the one photographed.

risks.risk: The gearbox may not be the Ford Fusion unit claimed, or may be for a different engine size, which sets the price and whether it fits
risks.proof: A sharp close up of the ID tag or sticker on the case showing the transmission code and part number
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; identity is the price driver

risks.risk: Internal wear: slipping, harsh shifts, burnt clutches or a bad valve body
risks.proof: A clip of the gearbox running in a car or on a test bench going through the gears, or a photo of the fluid on a white cloth
risks.if_unproven: as not working, rebuild core only

risks.risk: Cracked case, damaged mounting ears or leaking seals not visible from this side
risks.proof: Photos of the underside, oil pan and the other side of the case

risks.risk: Missing or damaged parts: electrical connector, solenoids, torque converter not original
risks.proof: A close up of the electrical connector and the full torque converter face

risks.risk: Dealer stock photo may not be the exact unit delivered
risks.proof: A photo of the gearbox with a handwritten note of today's date placed on it

proof_requests: A sharp close up of the ID tag or sticker on the gearbox case showing the transmission code and part number
A photo of the gearbox with a handwritten note of today's date on it
A clip of the gearbox running and shifting, or a photo of the fluid on a white cloth
Photos of the underside, oil pan and electrical connector
response.reason: This is clearly a used automatic transaxle, but no brand, transmission code or part number is legible, and the gearbox model sets both the price and the fit. A close up of the case ID tag is needed before even a worst case price is possible.
